title: Detailed paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Palette body: warm wood with shaded edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='41' ry='32' fill='#c98745'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='37' ry='28' fill='#e0a35c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='25' fill='#f0b86d'/>

  <!-- Thumb hole, shaded inside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#a86d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='9' ry='5.5' fill='#7a4a20'/>

  <!-- Paint blobs around the palette -->
  <!-- Red -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='35' r='6' fill='#e63946'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='33' r='1.6' fill='#ff7a82'/>
  <!-- Orange -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='28' r='6' fill='#f77f00'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='26' r='1.6' fill='#ffb04d'/>
  <!-- Yellow -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='26' r='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- Green -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='32' r='6' fill='#2a9d8f'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#6fd6c8'/>
  <!-- Blue -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#82b4ff'/>
  <!-- Purple -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='58' r='6' fill='#8338ec'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='56' r='1.6' fill='#b685ff'/>
  <!-- Pink -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='50' r='6' fill='#ff70a6'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- Teal -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='6' fill='#00b4d8'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='60' r='1.6' fill='#6bd9f0'/>

  <!-- Paint ridges / highlights on blobs -->
  <path d='M23 37 Q28 33 31 37' stroke='#ff9aa2' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M36 30 Q41 26 44 30' stroke='#ffb95e' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M51 28 Q56 24 59 28' stroke='#ffec99' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M65 34 Q70 30 73 34' stroke='#7fe0d3' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M74 46 Q79 42 82 46' stroke='#9ac2ff' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M72 60 Q77 56 80 60' stroke='#c9a1ff' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M20 52 Q25 48 28 52' stroke='#ffb3d1' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M20 64 Q25 60 28 64' stroke='#8ee6f7' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Small paint dab between blobs -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#e63946' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#2a9d8f' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='42' r='1.3' fill='#8338ec' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Wood grain lines -->
  <path d='M18 54 Q23 50 28 54' stroke='#c98745' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M70 44 Q75 40 80 44' stroke='#c98745' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Tiny paint drips -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='33' rx='1.8' ry='2.5' fill='#f77f00'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='27' rx='1.5' ry='2.2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='50' rx='1.5' ry='2.2' fill='#3a86ff'/>
</svg>
